newsitem.title: USA: Earthgrains extends buy-sell share program.
newsitem.headline: Earthgrains extends buy-sell share program.

text.p: Earthgrains Co said Tuesday that its deadline for the voluntary buy-sell program for small shareholders has been extended to March 20.
Under the previously announced program, shareholders with fewer than 100 shares of Earthgrains common stock as of December 27, 1996, may buy stock to reach 100 shares or sell all of their shares.
Participants will pay a processing fee of $0.90 per share, up to a maximum of $40, to defray the program's cost.
Participating shareholders will pay or receive a uniform a market-based price per share.
Shares will be bought or sold on the open market through a designated broker.
Earthgrains will neither buy nor sell any of the shares.
Earthgrains makes baked goods and refrigerated dough products.
